sources.title: ElecFreaks HC-SR04
sources.ref: https://cdn.sparkfun.com/datasheets/Sensors/Proximity/HCSR04.pdf operating voltage 5 V DC, working current 0.015 A, 40 kHz, range 0.02 to 4 m, measuring angle 0.2618 rad full (0.1309 rad half), trigger at least 10e-6 s, range = high time * 340 m/s / 2. The module outline is 0.045 x 0.020 x 0.015 m.

sources.title: Assumed timing, until M3 and M4
sources.ref: Echo rises 200e-6 s after Trig falls: one 8-cycle burst at 40 kHz. A scope on Trig and Echo settles it (M3). With nothing in range, Echo stays high for 0.038 s. M4 times that pulse. Logic thresholds are vil 0.9 V and vih 2.0 V so a Nano pin can drive Trig, and Echo vol 0.4 V voh 4.5 V. Not printed on the sheet (M8).

sources.title: Assumed supply, until M8
sources.ref: Idle current 0.002 A. The sheet states the 0.015 A working current and 5 V, not the idle draw and not a cutoff. vMin 3.0 V is assumed so a servo sag does not drop the echo; M8 measures the current and the voltage where the module stops.

sources.title: Speed of sound
sources.ref: 343 m/s at 20 C. The sheet uses 340 m/s. The 58e-6 s/cm rule is 344.8 m/s (2 * 0.01 / 58e-6). At 0.10 m the echo is 583e-6 s at 343, 588e-6 s at 340, and 580e-6 s by the 58 rule. The sketch divides microseconds by 58; this part emits 2d/343.

sources.title: Transducer plane
sources.ref: The ray starts 0.0128 m along local +Y from the part origin: half of the 0.0016 m board plus the 0.012 m can. Both can figures are marked verify in examples/gauge/cad/lib/dimensions.py. M3 can move the plane.
